s: A'ad denies Allah's revelations
q: They denied the revelations of their Lord

s: A'ad flouts messengers (Allah's messengers)
q: and flouted His messengers

s: A'ad follows the command of every froward potentate
q: and followed the command of every froward potentate.

s: A'ad has a curse (in the world and on the Day of Resurrection)
q: And a curse was made to follow them in the world and on the Day of Resurrection.

s: Salih is a messenger (sent to Thamud)
q: And unto (the tribe of) Thamud (We sent) their brother Salih.

s: Salih is a brother (of Thamud)
q: And unto (the tribe of) Thamud (We sent) their brother Salih.

s: Salih calls to worship (of Allah alone)
q: He said: O my people! Serve Allah, Ye have no other Allah save Him.

s: Salih has a clear proof from his Lord
q: if I am (acting) on clear proof from my Lord

s: Allah is responsive responsive
q: Lo! my Lord is Nigh, Responsive.

s: Thamud receives the camel of Allah (as a token)
q: O my people! This is the camel of Allah, a token unto you

s: the camel of Allah is a token (for Thamud)
q: This is the camel of Allah, a token unto you

s: the camel of Allah feeds in Allah's earth (by permission)
q: so suffer her to feed in Allah's earth

s: the camel of Allah is harmed by Thamud (when they hamstrung her)
q: But they hamstrung her

s: Abraham receives good news (from Our messengers)
q: And Our messengers cam unto Abraham with good news.

s: Abraham is mild mild (imploring and penitent)
q: Lo! Abraham was mild, imploring, penitent.

s: Abraham is imploring imploring
q: Lo! Abraham was mild, imploring, penitent.

s: Abraham is penitent penitent
q: Lo! Abraham was mild, imploring, penitent.

s: Abraham pleads for the folk of Lot (before Allah)
q: he pleaded with Us on behalf of the folk of Lot.

s: Allah is strong strong
q: Lo, thy Lord! He is the Strong, the Mighty.

s: the messengers are sent to the folk of Lot (by Allah)
q: They said: Fear not! Lo! we are sent unto the folk of Lot.

s: the messengers bring good news (to Abraham)
q: And Our messengers cam unto Abraham with good news.

s: the folk of Lot commit abominations
q: and before then they used to commit abominations

s: Lot is a messenger (of Allah)
q: O Lot! Lo! we are messengers of thy Lord

s: Lot has guests (the messengers)
q: and degrade me not in (the person of) my guests.

s: Allah is mighty mighty
q: Lo, thy Lord! He is the Strong, the Mighty.

s: Lot's wife is destroyed with Lot's township (because the doom smites her)
q: all) save thy wife. Lo! that which smiteth them will smite her (also).

s: Lot's township is overthrown by Allah (when His command comes to pass)
q: We overthrew (that township) and rained upon it stones of clay

s: Midian is a folk (addressed by Shu'eyb)
q: And unto Midian (We sent) their brother Shu'eyb.

s: Shu'eyb is a messenger (sent to Midian)
q: And unto Midian (We sent) their brother Shu'eyb.

s: Shu'eyb calls for full measure (in justice)
q: O my people! Give full measure and full weight in justice

s: Shu'eyb calls for full weight (in justice)
q: O my people! Give full measure and full weight in justice

s: Shu'eyb seeks reform (as far as he is able)
q: I desire naught save reform so far as I am able.

s: Moses is sent with Allah's revelations (and a clear warrant)
q: And verily We sent Moses with Our revelations and a clear warrant

s: Moses is sent to Pharaoh
q: Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs

s: Allah is owner of praise
q: Lo! He is Owner of Praise, Owner of Glory!

s: Pharaoh goes before his people (on the Day of Resurrection)
q: He will go before his people on the Day of Resurrection

s: Pharaoh has no right guidance (his command)
q: and the command of Pharaoh was no right guide.

s: Pharaoh leads his people (to the Fire on the Day of Resurrection)
q: He will go before his people on the Day of Resurrection and will lead them to the Fire for watering-place.

s: the Fire is a watering-place (for Pharaoh's people)
q: and will lead them to the Fire for watering-place.
